entities.summary: Robert Michael Seay is an American former professional baseball relief pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball for the Tampa Bay Devil Rays from 2001 to 2004, the Colorado Rockies in 2005, and the Detroit Tigers from 2006 to 2009.
